# guteneo

> guteneo is a correspondence workspace for preparing and tracking documents by postal mail, email or fax, through the web or a connected assistant.

## Public resources
- [Home](https://guteneo.com/): service, channels and preparation journey.
- [Assistants](https://guteneo.com/assistants/): connection guides and host-specific limitations.
- [Developer guide](https://guteneo.com/developers/): API, OAuth, MCP and preparation/approval rules.
- [OpenAPI contract](https://guteneo.com/openapi.json): API operations, parameters and responses.
- [Support](https://guteneo.com/support/): help and contact.
- [Journal](https://guteneo.com/journal/): printing and correspondence history.

## Preparation and sending
Preparing a document or quote does not authorize sending. By default, a person reviews content, recipients, options and cost in guteneo before confirmation.
Expert mode starts disabled. Only an authenticated browser administrator may grant one OAuth connection a bounded, expiring mandate; an assistant cannot activate or extend it.
Channel availability depends on current service capabilities and configuration. Simulation or demonstration does not prove real delivery.
